summary: The user name associated to the session
description:
The .userName property contains the user name associated to the session. You can use it to identify the user within your code.

Web sessions: This property is an empty string by default. It can be set using the privileges property of the setPrivileges() function. Remote/Stored procedure sessions: This property returns the same user name as the Current user command. Standalone sessions: This property contains "designer" or the name set with the SET USER ALIAS command.

This property is read only for desktop sessions.
